Hi, I'm Anika

Product, marketing, and analytics, all in one curious package.

I'm a product manager at Carrier, building digital experiences for residential climate solutions. I work where product, technology, analytics, and go-to-market meet, which is exactly where I like to be.

I'm happiest using data, AI, and connected tech to make complicated things feel simple. Outside of work, I'm a curious traveler, a Pinterest board collector, and someone who can't help making things.
